company.shortDescription: autarc offers an OS for HVAC installers to install more heat pumps enabling SMB installers to scale sustainable solutions confidently.
company.description: With autarc we are building the leading heat pump OS for HVAC installers in Europe to accelerate the transition to low carbon homes. 30% of Europe's CO2 emissions result from heating, and we are at the forefront of combating this environmental concern. Through LiDAR technology and AI, we reduce the overall project time of heat pump installations by 50%.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $8,823,627, or 93.97% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,260,035 to $48,712,941, a 38.66x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
